## Completion Criterion

- [ ] Final facts match verification, traceability, baseline, archive, and project board.
- [ ] Reusable assets have discoverable pointers.
- [ ] Durable behavior changes received explicit learning approval.
- [ ] Tooling/code debt is not misrepresented as solved by documentation.
- [ ] The next action and deferred work are explicit.
